headline: Amazon holiday quarter: online stores up ~10%, North America margin ~9%, but $200B capex plan sinks shares.

metrics.comp_label: Online stores sales growth (ex-FX if available)

guidance_note: Q1 2026: net sales $173.5-178.5B (+11-15%), operating income $16.5-21.5B incl. ~$1B higher Amazon Leo costs; ~$200B 2026 capex.
key_messages: Online stores sales ~$83B, up ~10%, through the holiday quarter.
North America sales $127.1B (+10%); segment operating income $11.5B vs $9.3B, margin ~9.0%.
Q4 included ~$2.4B of special charges (tax/litigation, severance, physical-store impairments).
Jassy described stores growing briskly across North America and International.
macro_read: Solid ~10% online goods growth over the 2025 holidays signals resilient US e-commerce demand; investor focus was on AI capex, not the consumer.

sources.label: Futurum: Q4 FY2025 revenue beat, $200B capex
The Star/Reuters: shares tumble on capex

notes: Online stores growth is total growth, not a like-for-like comp. EPS is GAAP; Amazon reports no adjusted figure.
